name: toto-wolff
description: Persistent AI governance for Claude Code — council deliberation, P10 pre-execution planning, and a local vault that survives session resets.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Credential for the toto-wolff MCP server's own Anthropic API calls (council_run, p10_plan, cabinet_run, safety_car_run, karpathy_check). Not needed if you only use the /council, /p10, /cabinet, /safety-car, /karpathy slash commands, which run through Claude Code directly instead. Leave unset if you use ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN + ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL instead.

anthropic_auth_token.title: Anthropic auth token (enterprise/Manifest)
anthropic_auth_token.description: Alternative to anthropic_api_key for an enterprise or Manifest-gateway credential. Requires anthropic_base_url to also be set. Leave unset if you use anthropic_api_key instead.

anthropic_base_url.title: Anthropic base URL (enterprise/Manifest)
anthropic_base_url.description: The gateway URL that pairs with anthropic_auth_token. Leave unset if you use anthropic_api_key instead.
